notes: «قال أتيت عائشة أسألها»: Shurayh went to Aisha; her words («عليك بابن أبي طالب») direct him to Ali and are scene, not a link.
«فسألناه فقال» : Ali speaks, and the saying (three days and nights) is his, so Ali is the last link. The preposition «ب» before «ابن» is not part of the surface.
«قال وكان سفيان إذا ذكر عمرا أثنى عليه» is a remark by a narrator, not a route.
